```{r setup}

library(sentinelBurnR)

aoi_file <- system.file(
  "extdata",
  "sizewell_aoi.gpkg",
  package = "sentinelBurnR"
)

if (aoi_file == "") {
  aoi_file <- "inst/extdata/sizewell_aoi.gpkg"
}

aoi <- read_aoi(aoi_file)

images <- search_s2(
    aoi,
    start = "2026-05-01",
    end = "2026-06-15"
)

images

summary(images)

```
